description:
Kang Eui-Jun wakes up in the hospital after an accident, having lost his memory. The only person by his side is Eun Jae-Hyeon, who introduces himself as his boyfriend. Amidst his confusion and resistance, Eui-Jun gradually opens his heart to Jae-Hyeon’s tender care. But something feels off. Whenever he asks about the past, Jae-Hyeon subtly changes the subject, and at every crucial moment, he evades the question.

What is Eun Jae-Hyeon hiding? And what truth remains in his erased memories?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

*Note: The ninth story in the Sachungi: Neoreul Saenggakaneun Bom (사춘기: 너를 생각하는 봄) Collection.*
